name: trw-ui
description: Read-only TRW status pane, optional band and inbox doorbell for Claude Code. Optional adapter: TRW works unchanged without it.

band.title: Status band
band.description: Show a one-line TRW band above the prompt (the statusLine already shows the one-liner, so the default is off).

doorbell.title: Inbox doorbell
doorbell.description: off: nothing. notify: toast and badge when TRW peer messages arrive. wake: also submit a fixed pointer-only prompt (opt-in).

wake_min_interval_s.title: Wake minimum interval (s)
wake_min_interval_s.description: Doorbell wake mode: minimum seconds between wake prompts.

poll_s.title: Poll interval (s)
poll_s.description: Seconds between status refreshes while the pane or band is visible, or the doorbell is on.

hidden_poll_s.title: Hidden poll interval (s)
hidden_poll_s.description: Seconds between doorbell checks while neither the pane nor the band is visible (never faster than poll_s).
